name: Live Studio（实时演播台）
rationale: The app is a background loop, so the first question on opening the window is "is it working, and what is it costing me?". It is not "which field do I edit?". Live Studio keeps that answer on screen at all times. A full-width "live deck" sits under the top bar and shows four things. (1) State, with a ring that counts down to the next capture (nextCycleAt). (2) Cache hit as a percentage, with a meter and cached/prompt tokens. (3) Request size against the effective limit, with a tick at 50% where compaction brings it back to. (4) Latency, with a 24-cycle sparkline. A ticker row under the deck shows the latest danmaku as chips. Settings move out of the 2,500px scroll into a left nav: two monitoring pages (总览, 生成日志) and seven task-sized settings pages. At 1120x760 every settings page fits on about one screen. Hard settings get pictures. The capture page shows the live request budget against both caps, and each 历史模式 is a radio card with a cache badge and a small sketch of the history window. The cadence page draws one cycle as a timeline: start delay, capture, generate, then a random wait that runs alongside the release window. The overview shows latency and cache hit for the last 24 cycles as two small charts that share the x-axis (not one chart with two y-axes), so the cache drop after a compaction is easy to see. Logs become a timeline of status nodes. Each row shows the comment preview and flags (缓存 %, 已截断, 压缩 N 张). The expanded entry groups the 15 detail fields into 请求 / 历史与缓存 / 输出与截图 and adds a truncation callout that links to the setting that fixes it. The look is calm and Windows 11 friendly: neutral graphite surfaces, one indigo accent, status colours used only for state, Fluent-style inputs with a strong bottom stroke, 32px controls, and Segoe UI Variable / YaHei UI. Unsaved edits show at three levels: the 保存 button (dot + Ctrl+S), a dot on the nav item, and an accent bar on each changed field label. Users can leave a page knowing nothing is lost silently. All text and token pairs pass WCAG AA (checked: muted text ≥5.0:1 on every surface in both themes, white on accent 6.4:1 light / 4.8:1 dark, input bottom stroke ≥3.4:1).
informationArchitecture:
SHELL (CSS grid rows: 52px top bar / live deck / optional banner / 1fr body; body = sidebar clamp(176px,18vw,212px) + scrolling content pane; only the content pane scrolls).

TOP BAR (left→right): logo + 弹幕伴侣 | profile switcher button "[layers] 配置 默认配置 [chevrons]" → popover (role=dialog): header 配置方案 + "N 套"; listbox of profiles (check on active, "当前" or "MM-DD 修改" from updatedAt; click = switchProfile, which auto-saves the draft first, and a note says so); "当前配置名称" input + 重命名 (disabled when empty or unchanged); "复制当前配置为新配置" input (placeholder 新配置名称) + 复制新建 (saves first); footer danger "删除“<name>”…" (window.confirm; disabled when only 1 profile). | spacer | 弹幕层 toggle (eye/eye-off, aria-pressed, setOverlayVisible) | 清空弹幕 icon button (eraser, clearOverlay) | divider | Save: clean = disabled "✓ 已保存"; dirty = "• 保存 Ctrl+S"; saving = spinner "保存中" | 生成一次 (sparkles; "生成中" while working) | primary 启动 (play) / 暂停 (pause) / "处理中".

LIVE DECK (always visible):
• State block: 60px ring + title + two lines. Running: green ring = remaining/total wait, centre "12 秒"; line "下次截图 HH:MM:SS"; line "第 N 轮 · 上次生成 HH:MM:SS". Variants: 启动延迟 (first wait after Start, ring labelled "首次截图"), 生成中 (running && !nextCycleAt: indeterminate spinning arc), 已暂停 (amber, empty ring with pause glyph), 空闲 (grey ring, play glyph), 错误 (red full ring with circle-alert; "手动生成失败 · 循环未运行").
• 缓存命中: "82%" + meter + "6,144 / 7,480 tokens" ("-" if unknown; "? / N" when cached is missing).
• 请求体: "3.1 MB / 48 MB" + meter with a 50% tick (the compaction target) + "历史截图 14 张 · 上限 24 张". Add tag "已按 413 下调" when requestLimitBytes < requestBodyLimitMB.
• 耗时: "2.4 s" + sparkline of the last 24 successful durationMs + "近 24 轮中位 2.5 s".
• Ticker: "最新弹幕" + chips (palette dot + text) from the newest log's comments (or live onDanmakuItems), fading out on the right; meta "第 N 轮 · K 条 · time".

BANNER SLOT (under the deck): status.lastError as a non-dismissable red bar "生成失败 <message>" + "查看日志 ›". actionError as a dismissable toast at the bottom right. Connection test result shows inline (model page callout + overview model card line), not as a global banner.

SIDEBAR: group 监控 → 总览 (#overview), 生成日志 (#logs, badge = log count). Group 设置 → 模型接口, 角色与用户, Prompt 模板, 弹幕样式, 运行节奏, 截图与历史, 隐私与存储. Each settings item shows an accent dot when its draft section differs from the saved config. Footer: "● host:port · 已连接/未连接" and "v<ver> · 配置仅存于本机".

PAGES (each has h1 + one-line description + optional right-aligned page actions):
1 总览: [最近 24 轮] card with two small-multiple column charts that share the x-axis (耗时 0–8 s; 缓存命中 0–100%). The latest bar uses the accent. Errors show as a red × at the baseline; aborted rounds and no-data rounds show as a grey dash. A note marks compaction dips ("第 35 轮压缩历史截图，重新预填充"). [最近生成] = 5 newest logs (status icon, time, preview or red error, n/m 条, duration, 自动/手动) and "全部 N 条 ›". Right column: [当前模型] (model id, 已加载/视觉/温度 tags, Base URL, 最大输出/超时/视觉输入 stats, 测试连接 + last result) and [生效参数] (rows link to their page: 截图间隔, 每轮弹幕+投放窗口, 对话历史 rounds+mode, 历史截图 on/off+caps, 截图 px+format+quality, 排除弹幕层).
2 生成日志: actions = segmented filter 全部/成功/失败 N (client-side), 刷新, 清空日志 (danger). Day-grouped timeline (rail + status nodes: ok check / warn triangle when truncated or compacted / err × / aborted pause). Row: completedAt time, #cycle, comment preview (red error text, or "已暂停，本轮中断"), flags (缓存 %, 已截断, 压缩 N 张, 已缩小, 失败后清空历史), duration, generated/requested 条, WxH or 无截图/截图失败 (column hidden below 1060px), 自动/手动, chevron. Expanded detail: 弹幕 chips; warn callout when finishReason=length ("…可以在 模型接口 调大“最大输出”"); danger callouts for log.error and screen.error; 3 sections — 请求 (模型, 请求体 size/limit + meter, 历史压缩 via compactionLabel, 投放窗口, 开始时间), 历史与缓存 (历史轮数, 历史模式 as its Chinese label, 历史截图 "保留 · 本次 N 张"/"不保留", 缓存/输入 + meter, 预填充), 输出与截图 (输出 tokens + truncation, 截图来源, 截图格式 "JPEG · q82", 图片大小, 传输大小 + "已缩小以适应上限"); 原始输出 <details> with character count and copy button; footer "第 N 轮 · 自动 · 开始…完成…耗时". "显示更早的 N 条" loads 100 more.
3 模型接口: action 测试连接. [连接] Base URL (mono); API Key (password + reveal button inside the field, aside "本地服务通常留空"); 模型 select (free-text input when the list is empty) + refresh icon button + note (count · state · 视觉, or red error message); test result callout (ok/err + endpoint). [视觉输入] switch 发送截图（视觉输入）. [生成参数] 温度 slider+number 0–2 (dimmed when sendTemperature is off); switch 发送温度参数; 最大输出 (tokens); 超时 (ms, hint "= 45 秒").
4 角色与用户: [角色] 角色名, 语言 (datalist zh-CN/ja-JP/en-US), 人设 textarea, 语气. [用户] 用户称呼, 用户身份. [占位符取值] read-only preview + link "编辑模板".
5 Prompt 模板: card whose header is a segmented tab 系统提示词 / 用户提示词 (tag "空" when empty). Placeholder chips insert at the caret; {{activeApp}} is a dashed chip + 未实现 tag + tooltip. Mono editor; footer shows line/char count and "用户提示词留空时，用户消息只包含截图". Right panel [当前取值]: every placeholder with its resolved value ({{requestedCount}} = itemsPerCycle, {{jsonShape}}, {{activeApp}} = unknown · 未实现).
6 弹幕样式: live preview stage (actual px size, palette colours, opacity, shadow, zone band). [文字] 字号 slider+px, 不透明度 slider, 单条最多字数, 文字阴影 switch. [配色] swatch tiles + comma-list input ("逗号分隔的 CSS 颜色"; invalid entries listed in a red hint). [运动与区域] 显示区域 segmented 全屏/上部/中部/下部 with zone glyphs, 滚动时长 slider+秒 ("越大越慢"), 密度 slider. [截图与录屏] switch 截图时排除弹幕层 + warn callout about OBS (and Windows 10 2004+).
7 运行节奏: [一轮的时间线] diagram (启动 → 延迟 N 秒 → 截图 → 生成 ≈median → 等待 min–max 秒（随机） → 截图, plus a parallel 投放 K 条 · min–max 秒 bar with K dots). [截图间隔] 最短间隔, 最长间隔, 启动延迟. [每轮投放] 每轮弹幕, 投放窗口最短, 投放窗口最长.
8 截图与历史: [当前请求预算] two meters — 请求体 vs effective limit and 历史截图 vs cap — each with a 50% tick and labels, plus the compaction explanation. [截图] 截图最长边 px, 截图格式 segmented JPEG/PNG, JPEG 质量 slider+number (disabled for PNG), hint with average image/transfer size from the last 10 logs; warn callout when PNG is selected and history screenshots are on. [历史截图与请求体] switch 保留历史截图 (with description), 历史截图上限 张, 请求体上限 MB, info callout (413 auto-compact + retry, connection reset ≥8 MB retried at half size, PNG ≈10× JPEG). [对话历史] 历史轮数, 历史模式 radio cards: 满额重置 / 分批滑动（缓存友好 · 推荐） / 逐轮滑动（每轮失去缓存）, each with a window sketch.
9 隐私与存储: [数据去向] flow chips 屏幕截图 → endpoint [本机/远程 tag] → 弹幕文字 + explanation. [截图隐私] 隐私黑名单 (disabled + 未实现 + hint), switch 保存截图到磁盘 (disabled + 未实现). [日志] 日志保留 条. [系统权限] (rendered only on macOS) 录屏权限 → 打开系统设置.
tokens:
FONTS: --font: "Segoe UI Variable Text","Segoe UI","Microsoft YaHei UI","Microsoft YaHei","PingFang SC","Hiragino Sans GB",system-ui,sans-serif. --mono: "Cascadia Mono",Consolas,"JetBrains Mono",ui-monospace,Menlo,"Microsoft YaHei UI",monospace.

TYPE SCALE (px / weight): 10.5 chart ticks · 11–11.5 micro (nav group labels 600, hints, tags 500) · 12 captions/meta · 12.5 field labels (500), body-small, callouts · 13 base body/inputs (line-height 1.5) · 13.5 card titles (600) · 14 brand · 15 model id (600) · 18 page h1 / state title (600) · 19 ring number (600) · 20 budget values · 22 hero metric values (600, letter-spacing -0.01em, proportional figures). Use tabular-nums only in columns (times, durations, table cells, axes).

SPACING: 4 / 6 / 8 / 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 24. Content padding 16 24 32. Card gap 12. Card head min-height 44 (padding 6 12 6 16). Card body 14 16 16. Field gap 5 (label→control). Field grid gap 14 row / 12 col.
SIZES: control height 32 (all buttons, inputs, segmented 28+2+2, switch row ≥32 hit area). Nav item 34. Top bar 52. Ticker 40. Ring 60 (r 25, stroke 5). Meter 6 (budget 8, detail 4). Chart plot 64 high, bars ≤12 wide, 3px rounded top.
RADII: --r-xs 4 (tooltips), --r-sm 6 (controls), --r-md 8 (callouts, seg group, radio cards), --r-lg 10 (cards, timeline rows), 999 chips/tags/switch.
SHADOWS: light --shadow-sm 0 1px 2px rgba(16,24,40,.05); --shadow-pop 0 16px 40px rgba(16,24,40,.16), 0 2px 6px rgba(16,24,40,.08). Dark: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.3); 0 18px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.55), 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.4).

COLOURS light / dark:
--bg #f3f4f7 / #0f1115 (window, sidebar)
--surface #ffffff / #171a21 (top bar, deck, cards)
--surface-2 #f8f9fb / #1b1f27 (ticker, insets, open log row)
--surface-3 #eef0f4 / #222732 (segmented track, neutral tags)
--hover #f1f3f6 / #1f232c; --active #e8ebf0 / #262b36; --nav-hover #e8eaef / #1b1f27
--border #e2e5eb / #282d38; --border-soft #eceef2 / #21252f
--ctl-bg #ffffff / #12151b; --ctl-border #d3d7de / #343a47; --ctl-strong (input bottom stroke, switch outline) #838b99 / #79818f
--ink #16181d / #e9ebf0; --ink-2 #454b57 / #b6bcc8; --ink-3 (muted, still AA) #5d6472 / #8f96a4
--accent (meters, sparkline, indicators) #4b5ce0 / #7383f5
--accent-solid (primary bg, white text) #3f50d2 / #5465e4; hover #3443bd / #6273ee
--accent-ink (links, active icons) #3343c0 / #a4afff; --accent-soft #eef0fd / #1f2545; --accent-border #c5cbf6 / #3a4482; --accent-track #e0e4fa / #272e55; --focus #3f50d2 / #8c99ff
--chart-bar (de-emphasised bars) #9aa4ee / #5b67b8; --chart-grid #e9ebf0 / #232833; --ring-track #e6e8ee / #262b36
Status (state only, always with icon + label): ok fill #16a34a / #22c55e, ok-ink #157538 / #5fdc8c, ok-soft #e6f5eb / #10261a, ok-border #b9e2c6 / #1f4d31 · warn fill #d97706 / #f59e0b, ink #8f4705 / #f7c060, soft #fdf3e2 / #2a2010, border #f2d6a6 / #574018 · danger fill #dc2626 / #ef4444, ink #b42020 / #fb8a8a, soft #fdecec / #2c1517, border #f3c1c1 / #5c2629 · idle #8a909b / #7b8290.
Preview stage: light linear-gradient(160deg,#1d2333,#222a3d 55%,#2c2438); dark linear-gradient(160deg,#0b0e15,#121726 55%,#1a1424).
Measured contrast: ink-3 on surface 5.95 / 5.86, on bg 5.41 / 6.36, on surface-3 5.21 / 5.03; white on accent-solid 6.38 / 4.82; accent-ink on accent-soft 6.85 / 7.21; ok/warn/danger ink on their soft ≥5.1; ctl-strong vs surface 3.43 / 4.44 (non-text ≥3).
components:
BUTTON (.btn, 32px, radius 6, 500 weight, icon 16 + 6px gap). Variants: secondary (surface bg, ctl-border), primary (accent-solid, white), ghost (transparent), icon (32×32, needs aria-label + title), danger (danger-ink text; hover danger-soft bg + danger-border), toggle (aria-pressed=true → accent-soft bg, accent-border, accent-ink), link-btn (accent-ink text, underline on hover, min-height 32). States: hover = --hover bg; active = --active; focus-visible = 2px --focus outline, offset 2; disabled = ink-3 text, transparent bg, border colour, default cursor; busy = LoaderCircle spinning in place of the icon, label changes (生成中 / 处理中 / 保存中), width kept stable.
SAVE BUTTON: clean → disabled "✓ 已保存"; dirty → accent-border/accent-ink + 7px accent dot + "保存" + muted "Ctrl+S"; saving → spinner. Ctrl+S shortcut is global.
PROFILE SWITCHER: ghost button (max-width 260, name ellipsis) → 340px popover, shadow-pop, radius 10. Listbox rows 34px (selected = accent-soft + check). Inline sections separated by border-soft. Esc closes, focus returns to the trigger, outside click closes, arrow keys move through the list.
LIVE DECK: 4-column grid (minmax(272px,1.15fr) + 3×1fr), hairline dividers. RingTimer (role=timer, aria-label "距离下次截图 N 秒"), states: countdown (ok stroke), start-delay (same, centre caption "首次截图"), generating (indeterminate 25% arc rotating 1.2s; static under prefers-reduced-motion), paused (warn, pause glyph), idle (idle grey, play glyph), error (danger full ring + circle-alert). Live dot pulses only while running (no animation under reduced motion). Metric: label row (14px icon + 12px ink-2), value 22/600 with small unit, meter, caption 12 ink-3 with ellipsis.
METER (role=meter + aria-valuenow/min/max/label): track accent-track, fill accent (warn ≥75%, danger ≥90% for request size), optional .mark tick (2px, ink-3 at 55% opacity) at the compaction target.
SPARKLINE: 72×26 SVG polyline 2px accent, end dot r3.5 with 2px surface ring; aria-hidden (the caption carries the number).
CHIP (danmaku text): 26px pill, surface bg, border, 8px palette dot with a 1px ring (so white palette entries stay visible), ink text (never palette-coloured text in the UI chrome).
NAV ITEM: 34px, icon ink-3. Hover nav-hover. Current = surface bg + inset border + shadow-sm + 3px accent bar on the left + accent-ink icon + 600 weight (aria-current=page). Badge (count) or dirty dot (7px accent, title "有未保存的修改").
CARD: surface, 1px border, radius 10, shadow-sm. Head: 16px ink-3 icon + 13.5/600 title + optional muted subtitle + right actions.
FIELD: label 12.5/500 ink-2 (always a real <label for>, or aria-labelledby for groups); right-aligned .aside (range or unit, 11.5 ink-3); hint 11.5 ink-3 below (ok = ok-ink, err = danger-ink). Modified field: 3px×12px accent bar before the label text plus "已修改" in the aside.
INPUT: 32px, radius 6, 1px ctl-border all round with the bottom edge in ctl-strong (Fluent look, ≥3:1). Hover ctl-hover. Focus: border accent-border, bottom accent + inset 1px accent underline + 3px accent-soft halo. Invalid: bottom border + underline danger, aria-invalid, hint.err. Disabled: surface-2 bg, ink-3, not-allowed cursor. Number inputs hide spinners and show a unit suffix inside (秒/px/MB/张/条/tokens/ms). Arrow Up/Down keep the step behaviour. Typed text is kept until blur (existing NumberField logic).
SELECT: native select with appearance:none inside .select-wrap and an inline lucide chevron-down (pointer-events none).
SWITCH: native <input type=checkbox role=switch>, 40×22, off = switch-off bg with ctl-strong outline and ink-2 knob; on = accent-solid with white knob. Always inside a full-width <label class=sw-row> (title 13/500 + 12px description), so the whole row is the hit target. Disabled row: ink-3 title, 45% switch, not-allowed cursor.
SEGMENTED: radio group in a surface-3 track (8px radius, 2px padding). Options 28px. Checked = surface bg + 1px border ring + small shadow. Keyboard via native radios, focus ring on the visible span. Block variant fills the width.
RANGE COMBO: native range (accent-color accent-solid, 32px tall) + 88px number input sharing one label (range has aria-label "<name>滑块").
RADIO CARD (history mode): 8px radius, 16px native radio, title 600 + optional status tag, 12px description, mini window sketch (10×8 cells: kept = chart-bar, dropped = outlined, new = accent-solid). Checked = accent-soft bg + accent-border ring.
TAG: 20px pill, 11.5/500: neutral (surface-3/ink-2), accent, ok, warn, danger, todo (warn-soft/warn-ink, text 未实现 + title tooltip with the unimplementedHints text).
CALLOUT: icon + text, radius 8. Variants neutral/info/ok/warn (danger for errors); may contain a bullet list.
STATUS BANNER: full-width under the deck, danger-soft bg, danger-border bottom; message ellipsis on one line (full text in title); "查看日志 ›" link. TOAST: bottom-right, max 420px, danger border, shadow-pop, close icon button; auto-dismiss is not required (it mirrors actionError).
MINI COLUMN CHART: 36px y-axis column (3 ticks), 64px plot, hairline gridlines at 0/50/100%, CSS grid of 24 equal columns, bars ≤12px with 3px rounded top. Per-bar tooltip on hover/focus ("#35 · 6.9 s"). Error marker × in danger-ink, abort/no-data marker = 10×2 grey dash. Shared x-axis labels every 6 cycles plus last. Legend chips 失败/中断 in the card head.
TIMELINE ENTRY: grid [32px node | card]. Day header with hollow dot. Node 26px circle (status-soft bg, status-ink icon, 4px bg ring) on a 2px rail. Row is a <button aria-expanded aria-controls> (42px, radius 10) with an sr-only status word. Open = surface-2 head, square bottom corners, detail panel attached. Detail grid = auto-fit minmax(240px,1fr) with 1px gaps as dividers (wraps to 2 columns at minimum width). Raw output <details> with mono <pre> (max-height 180, scroll) and a copy button.
PLACEHOLDER CHIP: 28px mono button with a plus icon; hover accent-soft. Inserts at the textarea caret (setRangeText) and refocuses. Unimplemented = dashed + 未实现 tag.
PREVIEW STAGE: 196px dark gradient with faux windows. Danmaku rendered with the real overlay style (800 weight, palette colours, opacity, shadow toggle) at the configured px size. Zone band overlay for top/middle/bottom. Caption pill "实际字号预览 · <zone> · <px>".
FLOW DIAGRAM (cadence): 6-column grid of blocks (start, hatched delay, capture = accent-solid, generate = accent-soft, wait = surface-3, capture). A parallel ok-soft release bar under the wait start, with one dot per comment. Captions in grid spans.
overlayStyleIdeas:
Keep the current overlay mechanics (lanes, 800 weight, palette colour per comment, translateX animation). Style options for the overlay itself, each a candidate DanmakuStyleSettings addition:
1) Outline instead of drop shadow: add a "描边" mode using `paint-order: stroke fill; -webkit-text-stroke: max(1.5px, 0.08em) rgba(0,0,0,.55)`. Bilibili uses this and it reads better than blur shadows on bright or busy screens. Keep the current two-layer shadow as the "阴影" option and add "无" for a third. Render the setting as a segmented control 描边/阴影/无.
2) Soft edge fade: mask the overlay root with `mask-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0, #000 48px, #000 calc(100% - 48px), transparent)` so comments fade in at the right edge and out at the left instead of popping. This is cheap because it sits on one element.
3) Optional "气泡" (bubble) style for low-density companion use: each line gets a translucent pill (rgba(15,17,21,.45) bg, 6px 12px padding, 999px radius, backdrop-filter: blur(6px)), with a 3px left bar or small dot in the palette colour while the text stays near-white. This is more legible over text-heavy screens (code, documents) and feels like a companion chatting rather than a crowd.
4) Optional character badge: prefix the first comment of each round with a tiny avatar circle or the character's initial ("M") in the accent colour, so the danmaku clearly comes from Mika and not from a live chat.
5) Colour safety: render palette colours with a minimum-luminance guard. If a colour is too dark to read over typical content (relative luminance < 0.18), the outline flips to white rgba(255,255,255,.6). Default palette: keep #31c3a2 #f59e0b #ef476f #5b8def #f8fafc and nudge the blue to #6b9cff for brightness.
6) Motion: use `will-change: transform` per line. Under prefers-reduced-motion, swap scrolling for a fade-in / hold (speedSeconds) / fade-out at a fixed lane position.
7) Size rhythm: vary font-size ±8% per comment (deterministic from the id) and drop opacity to 0.85 for comments released late in the window. This gives depth without random clutter.
8) Respect zone visually in the settings preview: the same band (top/middle/bottom thirds) the lane planner uses, so what users see in the preview stage matches the overlay.
implementationNotes:
STRUCTURE (React + plain CSS, no framework):
- src/renderer/settings/: SettingsShell.tsx (grid shell + page state), TopBar.tsx, ProfileSwitcher.tsx (popover), LiveDeck.tsx (RingTimer, MetricCache, MetricRequest, MetricLatency, DanmakuTicker), StatusBanner.tsx, Toast.tsx, Sidebar.tsx, pages/{Overview,Logs,Model,Character,Prompt,Danmaku,Cadence,Capture,Privacy}Page.tsx, ui/{Button,Field,NumberField,RangeField,ListField,Switch,Segmented,RadioCard,Tag,Callout,Meter,Sparkline,MiniColumns,Card}.tsx, logs/{LogTimeline,LogRow,LogDetail}.tsx.
- Split today's SettingsApp state into hooks and keep the logic unchanged: useSettingsDraft (config/draft/dirty/save/adoptConfig/rebaseDraft/editSection), useRuntimeStatus (subscribe + reload logs on broadcast), useProfiles (create/rename/switch/delete, all saving first where they do today), useModelList, useGenerationLogs (memoised entries, 100-per-page).
- Page routing: a `page` state persisted in localStorage (wrap in try/catch); no router needed. Keep all pages mounted lazily (render only the active one). Logs memoisation stays keyed on id.
- Dirty granularity: sectionDirty = JSON.stringify(draft[s]) !== JSON.stringify(config[s]) for model/character/user/prompt/danmaku/runtime. Map sections to nav items: character+user → 角色与用户; runtime fields split by page (cadence: interval*/startDelay/items/releaseWindow*; capture: capture*/history*/requestBodyLimitMB; privacy: generationLogLimit/privacyBlacklist/persistScreenshots); danmaku.excludeOverlayFromCapture → 弹幕样式. Per-field "modified" = value !== config value → add .is-modified on the Field.
- Countdown ring: keep a ref {nextCycleAt, firstSeenAt}. When status.nextCycleAt changes, set firstSeenAt = Date.now(). fraction = (due - now) / (due - firstSeenAt). Tick with a 1 s interval only while nextCycleAt is set; render the seconds with Math.ceil. "启动延迟" label: set a flag when start() resolves and clear it when status.cycles increases. running && !nextCycleAt ⇒ 生成中 (indeterminate). Do not re-render the whole app every second: isolate the ticking in RingTimer.
- Charts derive from generationLogs (no new IPC). last24 = logs sorted by cycle, take 24. Latency = durationMs for success. Cache = cachedInputTokens/promptTokens. Mark error/aborted. Medians computed client-side. Compaction note from log.compaction / historyRecovery. Average screenshot size hint = mean of screen.imageBytes / dataUrlBytes over the last 10 captured logs.
- Map raw enums to Chinese labels in one place (historyMode: reset-on-limit 满额重置, batch-sliding 分批滑动, sliding 逐轮滑动). Logs currently print the raw value.
- CSS: one tokens.css with :root light values and @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) overrides (Electron follows the OS through nativeTheme). Set `color-scheme` per theme so native scrollbars, range and select popups match. Component CSS uses only var(--…). Avoid color-mix for wider safety. :has() is used only for radio-card checked styling; it is supported in Electron ≥ 25, but a `.is-checked` class is a simple fallback.
- Layout pitfalls found while building the mockup: (1) the root grid needs `grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr)` and `min-width:0` on its children, or the ticker's non-shrinking chips stretch the whole window wider than 940px (horizontal scroll). (2) Each flex/grid text container that ellipsizes needs min-width:0. (3) A `[hidden]{display:none!important}` rule is needed because .btn sets display:inline-flex. (4) Rotate only the ring's own SVG (`.ring > svg`), not icons inside it. (5) Only the content pane scrolls (overflow:auto). The sidebar has its own overflow so it still works at 660px height.
- Width behaviour: sidebar clamp(176px,18vw,212px). Hero first column minmax(272px,1.15fr). Overview grid minmax(0,1.65fr) minmax(250px,1fr). Settings pages use 2-column card grids. Log rows drop the resolution column under 1060px. The log detail grid auto-fits minmax(240px,1fr). All checked at 940×660 and 1120×760 with no horizontal scroll. Add body/min-width 940 as a guard only.
- CSP (index.html): default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'. Inline style props (CSS variables like --c for swatches) are fine. Prefer inline lucide-react icons over CSS data-URI chevrons, so icons inherit currentColor in both themes. No web fonts, no network.
- Accessibility: every control has a <label for> or aria-labelledby (segmented groups use role=radiogroup + aria-labelledby). Icon-only buttons have aria-label + title. Switches use role=switch on native checkboxes. Log rows are buttons with aria-expanded/aria-controls and an sr-only status word. Meters use role=meter. The ring uses role=timer, but do not announce every second (no aria-live on the countdown; put aria-live=polite on the state title only). The popover traps Tab, closes on Esc and returns focus. Focus outline is 2px --focus with offset 2 everywhere; inputs use the underline + halo. Animations stop under prefers-reduced-motion.
- Keyboard: Ctrl+S save. Optional Ctrl+Enter = 生成一次, F5 = 刷新日志.
- Placeholder insertion: textarea.setRangeText(token, start, end, 'end') then dispatch the draft update and refocus. Mark the {{activeApp}} chip with the existing unimplementedHints text.
- Keep today's behaviour: switching/creating profiles, start, generate once and test connection all saveDraft() first. Delete uses window.confirm. Overlay toggle aria-pressed reflects visibility. The macOS-only permission card renders only when isMac. The JPEG quality control is disabled when the format is PNG, and the PNG warning appears when format=png && historyIncludeImages.
- Build the mockup again with: node build.cjs (inlines sprite.svg.html, generates chart markup into mockup.html). Hash routes: #overview #logs #model #character #prompt #danmaku #cadence #capture #privacy, plus state variants #error and #profiles.
weaknesses:
- The always-visible deck (top bar 52 + deck about 148) takes about 200px of a 660–760px window. At the minimum height, settings pages get about 460px and most need some scrolling. A collapse-to-one-line deck mode (e.g. when the window is under 700px tall, or by user toggle) would be needed if this becomes a complaint.
- There are more surfaces to build than with a single form: charts, timeline, ring timer, preview stage, flow diagram, budget meters, radio-card sketches. That roughly doubles the renderer UI code and adds visual QA in two themes.
- Nine nav destinations mean some related settings are a click apart. runtime fields are spread over 运行节奏 / 截图与历史 / 隐私与存储, and 截图时排除弹幕层 sits under 弹幕样式, not capture. Users who scan for one setting may look in the wrong page (the 生效参数 links on 总览 partly mitigate this). A settings search box would help.
- Several displays are derived client-side from logs: median latency, 24-cycle charts, average screenshot size, the start-delay label, and the ring's total duration (estimated from when nextCycleAt was first seen). They can be slightly off after a window reload or when logs are cleared. A `cycleScheduledAt` or `cycleDurationMs` in RuntimeStatus would make the ring exact.
- The log status filter, the 已按 413 下调 tag, the API-key reveal button, outline/bubble overlay styles and keyboard shortcuts are new behaviour, not just restyling. They need small additions or can be dropped.
- The preview stage shows danmaku at actual pixel size on a fake desktop. It does not reproduce real lane planning, density or scroll motion, so it is a style preview, not a faithful simulation.
- Status colour carries the hero state (green running, red error). Both always come with a text label and icon, but the green ring could be confused with cache-hit "good" readings by some users. The cache meter deliberately uses the accent, not green, to avoid that.
- The mockup was rendered with Inter + WenQuanYi on Linux. On Windows, Segoe UI Variable / Microsoft YaHei UI metrics differ slightly (YaHei is wider), so the tight spots need checking in the real app at 940px: hero captions, log row flags, the topbar profile name.
